anchor_gpu_metric: sum of engine per-viewport GPU durations, not total frame critical path
cpu_metric: anchor viewport render CPU sum and global frame setup separately; excludes script, quilt and main viewport

gpu_pass_profile.interpretation: Intervals between adjacent engine GPU markers, aggregated by viewport role; may include barriers, transitions and idle time. Profile changes workload. Not hardware counters or proof of shader bottleneck.

metric: engine process delta; includes engine, preview, scheduling; not isolated GPU time or independent wall-clock measurement
wall_metric: Time.get_ticks_usec between consecutive process calls; includes scheduling and presentation
